rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when something is suitable or appropriate for a purpose or situation.

example.english: This outfit is proper for meeting clients.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 saam1 heoi3 gin3 haak3 zau6 ngaam1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when proper means excellent, high-quality, or really good rather than merely suitable.

example.english: The steak at this restaurant is really proper.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲牛扒真係正。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 ngau4 paa4 zan1 hai6 zing3

rows.note: Use this for a person who behaves properly and follows expected manners or rules.

example.english: That child is very proper at the dinner table and never needs reminding.
example.traditional: 嗰個細路食飯好規矩，唔使人哋提。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 sai3 lou6 sik6 faan6 hou2 gwai1 geoi2 m4 sai2 jan4 dei6 tai4

rows.note: Use this before a description when proper means complete, utter, or downright, as in an utter fool.

example.english: He is a proper idiot to believe that.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 sap6 zuk1 so4 zai2 gam3 dou1 seon3
